record.question: Mexico to impose tariff hike of upto _________ on India, Asia nations from 2026.
record.explanation: Official final key: C — 50%. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 2, printed Q3. This is a January 2026 current-affairs item about a stated tariff ceiling, not a universal tariff on every Indian product or a current trade-rate lookup.
